Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Folks:

1) Leandro requires you pay 1 during Untap to get any transfers during
Influence. However, what if you don't pay 1 and Leandro is somehow
sent to torpor during your turn? At that point, can you go ahead and
make your transfers? I'd think so, but want a ruling.

2) Is the Garou's additional strike optional??

T'anks,
Madman

Messages.Author: tetragr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <_r9w4.50632$Mg.7...@c01read03-admin.service.talkway.com>,

"Madman2001" <Mad...@madman.com> wrote:
> Folks:
>
> 1) Leandro requires you pay 1 during Untap to get any transfers during
> Influence. However, what if you don't pay 1 and Leandro is somehow
> sent to torpor during your turn? At that point, can you go ahead and
> make your transfers? I'd think so, but want a ruling.

No, Leandro's special ability triggers when it's ready during the
actual Methuselah's untap phase; so it doesn't matter if he
will goes in torpor later, the Methuselah who do not pays the blood
starting its turn with Leandro ready must lose all the transfers during
its/her (next) influence phase. At least i think so.

>
> 2) Is the Garou's additional strike optional??
>

No, it should be mandatory, since is no "optional" (maybe this
is an errata in card text).
Best.
